excerpt: Parquet table of 5407 sensor rows with dom_x, dom_y, dom_z, string, dom_number. In-ice rows equal the IceCube IC86 geometry to 2e-5 m; rows with dom_number 61-64 are the four IceTop DOMs of each station (strings 1-81).
title: GraphNeT geometry table icecube86.parquet (IceCube 86-string detector, incl. IceTop DOM positions)
